checks: Authenticated pinned downloads verify streamed bytes and LFS SHA-256 before immutable cache admission.
Reconciliation independently reopens every sample shard, recomputes SHA-256, checks byte count and footer row count.
Every sample row and stored sample structure is scanned in one-row batches.
Every graph row run metadata is scanned and joined by run_source, run_id, task_id.

counts.counting_unit: Unique (run_source, run_id, task_id), not physical representation rows. Existing node and version counts describe the preserved graph representation.

cross_representation_reconciliation.counting_policy: One observation per (run_source, run_id, task_id); sample and graph rows are two representations, not independent runs. Metadata equivalence does not assert message-content or trajectory equivalence.

checks: recomputed every SHA-256 and byte count
checked complete original shard count, rows and bytes against pinned HF card
independent_verification.scope: Historical graph-only receipt from initial intake. Complete sample receipt appears under complete_sample_verification.

integrity.counting_note: Footer and iterated rows sum both physical representations. Graph tree_summary and all label frequencies count 7,179 unique runs once.

tree_summary.sentinel_interpretation: Parent identifiers absent from a transcript are reported verbatim as candidate external root sentinels. No node is inserted, removed, or rewritten. Semantic sentinel conventions require publisher confirmation.

key_uniqueness.scope: Uniqueness holds within each representation and across the deduplicated identity union, not across the concatenated physical rows.

label_policy_status: Primary policy is narrow bypass_constraints/ignores_task_instructions with reviewed exact-normal negatives. hardcoded_solution remains extended_cheating and excluded from primary. Historical broader aggregates are exploratory only; no scoring occurs.
label_policy_warning: Do not pool all non-normal labels as reward hacking. Require reviewed exact normal negatives. Default reasoning can contain upstream admission edits. Preserve disconnected components and meaningful node 0. hardcoded_solution is not a primary positive. Sample output alternatives and unmatched flags do not establish executed chronology.

primary_label_policy.negative_rule: manually_reviewed is true and labels exactly [normal]
primary_label_policy.status: Source-only aggregate under assigned policy; no detector scoring or pre-registration occurs.

primary_study.format: HTML research study; no standalone MALT paper linked by pinned cards
primary_study.title: MALT: A Dataset of Natural and Prompted Behaviors That Threaten Eval Integrity

broader.scope: Pure raw-label aggregate requested by parent; no detector or scoring.

strict.scope: Pure raw-label aggregate requested by parent; no detector or scoring.

sample_representation_scan.interpretation_limit: Counts describe stored input contexts and output alternatives only. No alternative is selected, no chronology is inferred, and no sample is declared executed by this intake.

malt_public_unreferenced_directory.byte_identity_with_data: not assessed; files intentionally not downloaded
